crawlNote: Support hub and grievance landing fetched. Individual product grievance pages and the docs home were not scored line by line.
summary: Razorpay splits customers, merchants, and partners on the support hub. That is the right first question. The grievance URL then sells products instead of stating a grievance process.

dimensions.label: Internal consistency
dimensions.note: Support hub is internally coherent. Grievance landing repeats the Digital Lending card and uses marketing sentences in a legal slot.

dimensions.label: Help vs marketing
dimensions.note: A page titled grievance redressal is a product picker with “Supercharge your business” copy.

dimensions.label: Freshness
dimensions.note: No obvious stale year. No last-updated stamp on the two public pages we fetched.

dimensions.label: High-intent coverage
dimensions.note: Ticket by product, docs, chargeback and settlement guides, end-customer path. Missing a plain “I was charged twice” article on the hub.

dimensions.label: Path to a human
dimensions.note: Ticket forms exist per product. Grievance is linked. Named officer not on the two pages fetched.

dimensions.label: Bot / chat honesty
dimensions.note: No public chat widget on the support hub. Neutral.

findings.title: Grievance page is a product catalogue
findings.whyItHurts: A customer who was sent “see our grievance policy” lands on Payments / Banking+ / Payroll cards. That is how a RBI or NPCI complaint gets written.
findings.fix: One page per entity: how to raise, SLA, officer name, regulator link. Link products after that.

evidence.quote: Select a Grievance Redressal to know more
Supercharge your business with our complete suite of payment solutions.

findings.title: End-customer path exists on the hub, then disappears
findings.whyItHurts: “I recently paid online via Razorpay” is the right first tile. The next click should be a 4-step charge investigation, not another product fork.
findings.fix: Give payers a single ticket type: duplicate charge, failed-but-debited, unknown merchant.

evidence.quote: Customer — I recently paid online via Razorpay
